result.summary: Found 1 visible issue: a delivery fee value is rendering as an invalid NaN value.

issues.description: The second restaurant in the “Fastest near you” carousel shows “€NaN delivery” instead of a valid delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery fee calculation/data handling and provide a fallback such as “€0 delivery”, a specific fee, or “Delivery fee unavailable” when the value is missing.
